questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code keeps cached templates consistent with invalidation events? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Why does Get compare `c.gen[id]` and `c.epoch` with the values captured earlier before storing the loaded template?
choices: To avoid storing the same template twice
To make sure the TTL has not expired during the load
To skip caching a result whose load overlapped an invalidation, which could be an outdated version
To detect that another goroutine loaded the same template

questions.prompt: A template is not in the cache and a load for it is in flight. InvalidateAll runs, then the load finishes. What does the caller and the cache see?
choices: The caller gets the loaded template, but it is not stored in the cache
The caller gets an error because the epoch changed
The caller gets the loaded template and it is stored with a fresh TTL
The caller blocks until another load completes

questions.prompt: The events channel is closed by the publisher, and Listen returns. What is the effect on the cache?
choices: Existing entries keep being served until their TTL expires, after which they are reloaded
Entries are served indefinitely because nothing else expires them
